title: Pointer Lab — Full DSA Path
description: Linear structures, trees, graphs, DP, stacks, and binary search — always with real traces and teaching agents.

phases.title: Phase I — Linear Data Structures & Pointers
Phase II — Trees, Graphs, DP & Binary Search

topics.title: Arrays
topics.summary: Index-based access, in-place updates, and scanning patterns.

topics.title: Two Pointers
topics.summary: Move left and right indices together to shrink or expand a search space.

topics.title: Sliding Window
topics.summary: Maintain a window of elements and slide it to find optimal subarrays.

topics.title: Linked Lists
topics.summary: Follow next pointers, reverse links, and detect cycles safely.

topics.title: Trees
topics.summary: Traverse binary trees with recursion or stacks; reason about left/right children.

topics.title: Graphs
topics.summary: BFS and DFS over adjacency lists; track visited nodes to avoid cycles.

topics.title: Dynamic Programming
topics.summary: Define subproblems, fill a DP table bottom-up, and reuse overlapping answers.

topics.title: Stack
topics.summary: LIFO push/pop, matching brackets, and monotonic stacks for next-greater queries.

topics.title: Binary Search
topics.summary: Halve a sorted range with left/right/mid pointers; search answers and rotated arrays.
